description: This Java source file contains Android instrumentation tests for validating end-to-end Wi-Fi functionality, including enabling/disabling Wi-Fi, connecting to networks, and verifying network connectivity.

classes.name: WifiE2eTests
classes.description: JUnit4 test class for validating Wi-Fi functionality on Android devices.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes context and Wi-Fi management objects before each test.

methods.name: enableWifi
methods.description: Enables Wi-Fi and waits until it is active.

methods.name: disableWifi
methods.description: Disables Wi-Fi and waits until it is inactive.

methods.name: waitForSupplicantState
methods.description: Waits until the Wi-Fi supplicant reaches one of the expected states.

methods.name: enableNetwork
methods.description: Adds and enables a Wi-Fi network with the specified SSID.

methods.name: testWifiInitialization
methods.description: Test that initializes Wi-Fi by removing all configured networks and verifying the state.

methods.name: testWifiConnects
methods.description: Test that enables Wi-Fi, connects to specified networks, and verifies internet connectivity.
